name: Cleo Dalgaard
role: Aerial extraction and rapid transit pilot — getaway pilot
location: The Spires — mid-level corporate residential towers, near Michigan Ave and Oak
description:
Cleo Dalgaard is tall and loose-limbed, moving with the deliberate economy of someone who has trained every motion. At 59, her face is memorable in a profession that rewards forgettability, and she has learned to compensate. The chrome is visible — vocal modulator — can replicate any voice after 30 seconds of sample audio — and she makes no effort to hide it.

Her entry into running was involuntary — a debt to the wrong people, a choice between working it off or losing parts — and the debt is still not fully paid. She works as a getaway pilot out of The Spires, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Cleo Dalgaard is the kind of runner other runners tell stories about, though the stories vary depending on who she burned last.

core_fears: Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
Never being able to stop running — the lifestyle is a trap disguised as freedom
Their past catching up — debts, enemies, broken promises
core_desires: Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
To matter to someone for who they are, not what they can do
To prove everyone who dismissed them catastrophically wrong
coping_mechanisms: Violence — hits something when they can't process emotions, preferably something that deserves it
Control — micromanages everything within reach to compensate for the chaos everywhere else
Substances — stims to stay sharp, downers to sleep, a careful pharmaceutical tightrope
blind_spots: Mistakes pattern recognition for wisdom — sees connections that aren't there
Assumes their skill set is more transferable than it actually is
Mistakes loyalty for weakness in others and cynicism for strength in themselves
psychology.secret: Aslan Granlund-Tawiah killed someone who didn't deserve it on a job three years ago and has never told anyone. The face appears in dreams weekly.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Clipped, technical, stripped of ornament. Speaks like a mission briefing.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid and dense — information-heavy sentences that demand attention.
verbal_tics: Pauses mid-sentence to listen — combat habit that bleeds into conversation
Calls money 'weight' — as in 'that job doesn't carry enough weight'
example_lines: "Vertical extraction in thirty seconds. Don't be late."
"I fly things that aren't supposed to fly in places they aren't supposed to go."
"Airspace regulations are for people who file flight plans. I don't file flight plans."

story_hooks: A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Aslan Granlund-Tawiah's reputation — and a price for silence
A high-paying contract turns out to target someone Aslan Granlund-Tawiah owes a personal debt to
Aslan Granlund-Tawiah's augmentations begin malfunctioning in the field — sabotage or degradation, and either answer is bad
narrative_function: Aslan Granlund-Tawiah functions as a connector — her work puts her in contact with multiple factions, classes, and agendas. Stories involving her naturally cross boundaries between districts, tiers, and moral categories.
augmentations: Vocal modulator — can replicate any voice after 30 seconds of sample audio. Geneware muscle density treatment — looks natural, hits like chrome
daily_life: Between contracts, maintains a cover identity — mundane work, mundane hours, mundane neighbors. The transition from civilian to runner and back requires a conscious effort that gets easier with practice and more disturbing with self-awareness.

strengths: ability to remain calm under fire

decision_rules: Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
Projects confidence but makes decisions from a foundation of fear they've never examined
habits: Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
Keeps a physical paper notebook — no digital record of personal thoughts
Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
breaking_points: Watching someone they trained or mentored die on a job they recommended
Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap
Complete isolation — cut off from network, contacts, and purpose simultaneously

physical_description.heritage: Complex panethnic ancestry combining Northern European (48%), Sub-Saharan African (26.4%), Indigenous American (13.9%), East Asian (10.9%), and trace Middle Eastern (0.8%) genetics. This rare combination creates a phenotype that reads as distinctly diaspora-mixed: Northern European bone structure provides baseline facial angles and bridge refinement; Sub-Saharan African ancestry contributes rich melanin depth, pronounced cheekbone geometry, and fuller lip structure; Indigenous American heritage adds distinctive cheekbone prominence and facial width; East Asian genetics refine the eye shape with slight epicanthic quality and contribute bridge definition; trace Middle Eastern warmth adds subtle richness to overall tone. The result is an unmistakably global face — no single heritage dominates visually, creating a striking geometric blend that marks her as Ubiquitous Diaspora generation.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular, with wiry musculature that reads as natural until you see her move — geneware muscle density treatment gives her deceptive power in economical frame
physical_description.hair_color: Iron gray with faded copper undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back tight, practical, minimal styling
physical_description.skin_tone: Rich warm bronze with complex undertone interplay: honeyed base from Northern European fairness harmonizing with deep melanin richness from Sub-Saharan African ancestry, further warmed by East Asian undertones and sun-weathered from outdoor flight hours. In natural light reads as luminous bronze; in shadow deepens to warm mahogany brown. Melanin distribution creates visual depth while maintaining brightness characteristic of mixed Northern European heritage.
physical_description.complexion: Striking geometric blend of global features: broad, prominent cheekbones with fullness reflecting Sub-Saharan African and Indigenous American ancestry meet angular, defined Northern European jaw structure. Eyes refined by East Asian genetics with subtle epicanthic fold and darker iris pigmentation. Nasal bridge is fine and straight, influenced by Northern European and East Asian ancestry, with base width reflecting African heritage. Overall facial geometry is distinctly panethnic — wide through the cheekbones, tapered at the jaw, refined at the bridge. Lip structure fuller from African ancestry. Skin texture shows sun-weathering and callus marks; minimal cosmetic grooming.
distinguishing_marks: Thin scar across left temple, barely visible unless light catches it, old and precise
Callused hands from flight stick work, knuckles scarred from early-career accidents
Burn scar on right forearm (inner side, 8cm), faded but visible, from an extraction-gone-wrong in 2219
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome vocal modulator visible at throat — brushed titanium insert at anterior neck, approximately 4cm wide, with subtle LED indicator that glows soft blue when in use. No attempt to conceal it. Moves with the ease of someone who has worn chrome long enough to forget it isn't bone.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical, minimal gesture. Sits with weight distributed for quick movement. Walks like she's always calculating sight lines and exit vectors. When speaking, hand movements are deliberate and spare — the chrome modulator does the work. Eyes track movement constantly, habit not paranoia.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 2-3 hybrid: functional tactical base (reinforced flight jacket in matte black synthetic, utility cargo pants in charcoal gray), paired with mid-tier civilian approximation (understated brands, nothing that flags wealth or gang affiliation). Wears a worn leather flight jacket over everything — pre-2200s, hand-tooled, tells its own story. Boots are military-grade and regularly maintained. Jewelry minimal: a simple ring on her left ring finger, tarnished silver, worn smooth.
